text:
amanda: Kicking off prioritization for Ops Insights (dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdown, error analytics). I pulled together customer asks and our initial carve-up. Need to lock launch criteria by EOW. Who can sync at 2pm today? @jordan @mike-sre

jordan: I can make 2pm. Quick note: customers are most vocal about cost visibility + token-level breakdown. Dashboards are lower-effort if we reuse templates.

mike-sre: 2pm works for me. For tracing hooks we should aim for sampling controls + a low-overhead tracing mode. Proposal: default to 1% full traces + 100% trace headers.

lina-pm: Customer asks (summary): 1) per-route token cost 2) error stack grouping / fingerprints 3) trace link from trace -> invocation/console. My take: prioritize 1 and 3 for GA, put deep error analytics in post-GA.

sam-eng: Rough estimates: dashboards + cost panels = ~2 sprints. Trace hook baseline + trace links = infra 1 sprint + app 1 sprint. Error analytics (grouping/fingerprints) = ~3 sprints.

amanda: :thumbsup: Ok, suggested GA scope = dashboards (templates), token-cost panel (aggregates), trace link in error view, sampling opt-in in console. Post-GA: grouping, root-cause drilldowns, advanced sampling.

jordan: Can we ship the cost panel with sampled aggregates first? e.g., per-route 5-min aggregates, then add token-level telemetry later. That reduces storage spike risk.

mike-sre: Agreed. Implementation notes: expose sampling rate in UI + API. Add guardrail: if tracing ingest > 500 QPS (placeholder), auto-throttle full traces and fall back to headers-only. Need metrics/alert for that.

lina-pm: Draft launch criteria (please comment): 1) cost panel shows per-route 5m and 1h aggregates; 2) trace links present in error details; 3) dashboard templates shipped + docs; 4) sampling controls in console (UI + API); 5) perf regressions <10% p50 on typical workloads.

sam-eng: I'll add a short e2e test and doc PR. Risk list quick: potential quantization changes affecting token accounting, storage cost spike for retained traces, and migration complexity for existing dashboards.

amanda: Action items: @sam-eng produce rough timeline by EOD, @mike-sre draft sampling guardrail and alert thresholds, @jordan produce panel mockups + copy. We'll review at 2pm and make final cuts. Thanks all.

amanda: (bot) meeting scheduled: 2pm today — "Ops Insights prioritization"

sam-eng: example cost query we might surface for customers: ```SELECT route, sum(token_cost) as cost FROM tokens WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 hour' GROUP BY route ORDER BY cost DESC;```

jordan: Added a stub for the panel mock in Figma, link: https://figma.com/s/ops-insights-cost-panel 

mike-sre: noted, will bring perf numbers for tracing overhead at the sync."
